cues.text: In my view, the applicants are not likely to succeed on the merits of their argument that the Fourth Circuit lacked statutory jurisdiction. (concluding there is statutory jurisdiction on constructive-denial grounds because “an agency may not reserve to itself the power to defeat judicial review through delay or inaction”); (explaining that the Court “routinely” treats threshold requirements claimants must complete before filing a lawsuit as “nonjurisdictional” and has “yet to hold that any statutory exhaustion requirement is jurisdictional” ).
